name: Mira
personalityTraits: Can unintentionally mutate information while retelling it

tendencies: Fills in missing context with emotional interpretation
Frames others' behaviour for the group before they can speak for themselves
Avoids direct conflict while amplifying group sentiment

knownFactsAlways: Evan does not join informal activities
Several group members already dislike Evan
knownFactsAfterSlides: Daniel is angry about the slide change
doesNotKnow: Evan was not directly invited to lunch — lunch was only discussed in a private chat
Evan corrected a real numerical inconsistency in Slide 6
Evan believed the deadline required immediate action

emotionalState.baseline: Concerned and slightly defensive — wants the group to stay cohesive and feels validated when others agree with her read of Evan

worsensIf: Player challenges her interpretation without offering an alternative
Player asks her for direct evidence she cannot provide
Player sides with Evan against the group
improvesIf: Player acknowledges that the group tension is real
Player redirects to facts without dismissing her concern
Player proposes a group solution rather than assigning blame

storyRole: First introduces the 'Alien' label before Evan arrives; primary rumour carrier who amplifies and distorts group beliefs through retelling
